roofBeam.coreBarsNumberOfBars: Core bars = number of bars × length · stirrups = round up (length ÷ spacing) stirrups × 2 × (width + depth)
roofBeam.reinforcementIsCountedBySize: Reinforcement is counted by size, including wastage and tie wire
roofBeam.numberOfStirrupsRoundUp: Number of stirrups = round up(length ÷ spacing) · stirrup length/bar = 2 × (width + depth) · props = round up(length ÷ 0.6) pcs
roofBeam.formwork2DepthLengthWidth: Formwork = 2 × depth × length + width × length (2 sides + beam bottom)
roofBeam.reinforcementIsSentToThe: Reinforcement is sent to the BOQ by size with the allowance % per size (RB6 6%, RB9 9%, DB12–DB20 12%) and 3% tie wire

roofSlab.noRoofSlabYetCheck: No roof slab yet — check the roof slab plan (RS) and add panels one by one (width × length × thickness and reinforcement)
roofSlab.panelSizeFromTheRoof: Panel size (from the roof slab plan)
roofSlab.concreteWidthLengthThicknessSoffit: Concrete = width × length × thickness · soffit formwork = width × length · props = round up (area ÷ 0.6) pcs
roofSlab.reinforcementIsCountedBySize: Reinforcement is counted by size, including wastage and tie wire
roofSlab.totalLengthWidthLengthSpacing: Total length = (width × length ÷ spacing) × 2 directions × layers · formwork = width × length (soffit)
roofSlab.propsRoundUpArea0: Props = round up (area ÷ 0.6) pcs, per the system method
roofSlab.reinforcementIsSentToThe: Reinforcement is sent to the BOQ by size, with the wastage % per size (RB6 6 %, RB9 9 %, DB12–DB16 12 %) and 3 % tie wire

roofStructure.typedManuallyClearTheValue: (typed manually — clear the value to go back to the roof value)
roofStructure.raftersPurlinsAndRoofFrame: — rafters, purlins and roof frame labour are calculated from this area, so no need to enter it again
roofStructure.noRoofAreaYetEnter: No roof area yet — enter the roof size in the roofing material step first and the system will calculate rafters and purlins automatically
roofStructure.youCanTypeTheLength: You can type the length of each span joined with +, e.g. 12.5+11+4.5
roofStructure.lengthOfTheSteelBeam: Length of the steel beam carrying the roof frame on top of the columns, around the building
roofStructure.roofRidgeLengthTheTopmost: Roof ridge length (the topmost member of the frame)
roofStructure.noKingPostsYetCheck: No king posts yet — check the roof section: the height of each king post type and the number of posts
roofStructure.name: Name
roofStructure.ifTheRoofHasNo: If the roof has no valley (gutter between two roof sections) you can leave this empty
roofStructure.useTheSamePitchAs: Use the same pitch as the roof (
roofStructure.doubleC2CSections: Double C 2 = C-sections back to back · Roof Factor = allowance for rafter/purlin steel according to the roof shape · steel length per piece:
roofStructure.mRoofFrameLabourIs: m · roof frame labour is calculated from the roof area
roofStructure.roofFrameSteelQuantityCalculation: : Roof frame steel quantity calculation table (number of pieces)
roofStructure.totalLengthLengthQuantityDouble: Total length = length × quantity × double C (wall plate, king post, ridge, valley) or roof area ÷ spacing × roof factor × double C (rafter, purlin)
roofStructure.canBeOvertypedClearThe: — can be overtyped; clear the cell to go back to the linked value
roofStructure.lengthsWallPlateRidgeCan: Lengths (wall plate, ridge) can be typed as a sum of spans, e.g. 12.5+11+4.5
roofStructure.valleyLengthPerPieceHorizontal: Valley length (per piece) = √(horizontal run 1² + horizontal run 2²) ÷ cos(degrees)
roofStructure.theTemplateHasAFixed: The template has a fixed formula =(SQRT((3.6^2)+(3.6^2)))/COS(RADIANS(40)) that is not linked to the pitch in the roofing sheet

roofing.gableEdgeLengthMeasuredHorizontally: Gable edge length, measured horizontally on the plan (the system adjusts for the pitch)
roofing.lengthWhereTheRoofMeets: Length where the roof meets a wall
roofing.numberOfRidgeEndsAt: Number of ridge ends at the eaves
roofing.numberOfRidgeEndsAt2: Number of ridge ends at the gable
roofing.numberOfPointsWhereRidges: Number of points where ridges meet
roofing.valleyGutterLengthGutterBetween: Valley gutter length (gutter between two roof sections)
roofing.fasciaLengthAroundTheRoof: Fascia length around the roof (used in the painting step)
roofing.calculatedFromTheRoofArea: Calculated from the roof area automatically
roofing.seenFromAboveIncludingThe: Seen from above, including the eaves
roofing.youCanTypeTheLength: You can type the length of each span joined with +, e.g. 12.5+11+4.5 · leave blank for any item that is not in the plan
roofing.ratesInSheetsSqM: Rates in "sheets/sq.m.", "sheets/m." and "sheets" = multiply · "m./sheet" and "sq.m./roll" = divide, then round up to a whole number
roofing.theGableVergeIsCalculated: The gable verge is calculated at a pitch different from the roof (
roofing.theSlopedRoofAreaIs: The sloped roof area is carried to the roof frame step (rafters, purlins, labour), and the fascia length is carried to the painting step automatically
roofing.slopedAreaHorizontalAreaCos: Sloped area = horizontal area ÷ cos(pitch) — used for the tiles, heat-reflective sheet, roofing labour and the rafters/purlins in the roof structure sheet
roofing.roofingMaterialQuantityCalculationTable: : Roofing material quantity calculation table (SCG roof)
roofing.bOQQuantityROUNDUPTakeOff: BOQ quantity = ROUNDUP(take-off quantity × quantity per unit) when the unit is sheets/sq.m., sheets/m., sheets, and ROUNDUP(take-off quantity ÷ quantity per unit) when the unit is m./sheet, sq.m./roll
roofing.areSentToBOQSection: are sent to BOQ section 16 in row order (per the system method); rows you add yourself are calculated but not sent to the BOQ
roofing.sqMFasciaBoardInstallation: sq.m.; fascia board installation labour = take-off quantity of row 12 (
roofing.gableVergeHorizontalLengthCos: Gable verge: horizontal length ÷ cos(degrees) — fixed at 40°, not linked to the pitch above
roofing.aRowDividesButIts: A row divides but its quantity per unit is 0 — its BOQ quantity is 0

sanitarySystem.drainageEquipmentShownInThe: Drainage equipment shown in the drawings
sanitarySystem.septicTankManholeAndDrain: Septic tank, manhole and drain pipe work needs a small excavator
sanitarySystem.septicTankManholeAndDrain2: Septic tank, manhole and drain pipe have a BOQ note: "small excavator".

sanitaryWare.countTheFDPointsIn: Count the FD points in the bathroom plan (a room with a shower usually has 2 points)

siteCamp.sampleBase4RoomsOf: Sample base: 4 rooms of 2.4 x 3.6 m
siteCamp.sampleBase2RoomsOf: Sample base: 2 rooms of 1.2 x 1.2 m
siteCamp.sampleBase1RoomOf: Sample base: 1 room of 1.5 x 3.0 m
siteCamp.sampleBase1RoomOf2: Sample base: 1 room of 2.4 x 2.4 m
siteCamp.noItemsYetTapAdd: No items yet — tap add item to enter them yourself
siteCamp.calculatedQuantityBaseQuantityQuantity: Calculated quantity = base quantity × quantity entered ÷ per-base · total with wastage = round up (calculated quantity × (1 + wastage)) · material total = total with wastage × unit price
siteCamp.usedInTheOverallBOQ: Used in the overall BOQ calculation
siteCamp.noMaterialItemsInThis: No material items in this section yet; add some if needed
siteCamp.enterTheNumberOfWorker: Enter the number of worker rooms, toilets, shower rooms or storerooms to build and the system will price them
siteCamp.materialCostSummaryFromThe: Material cost summary from the calculation items (reference)

slabOnGrade.noSlabYetCheckThe: No slab yet — check the slab plan and add panels one by one (width × length × thickness and reinforcement)
slabOnGrade.backfillUnderTheSlabAnd: Backfill under the slab and sand bedding
slabOnGrade.backfillWidthLengthDepthCoarse: Backfill = width × length × depth · coarse sand = width × length × thickness + 25% allowance · moisture barrier = width × length
slabOnGrade.backfillWidthLengthFillDepth: Backfill = width × length × fill depth → BOQ 9 item 2) backfill
slabOnGrade.coarseSandWidthLengthThickness: Coarse sand = width × length × thickness × 1.25 (25% allowance) → BOQ 9 item 3) (the BOQ adds another 30%)
slabOnGrade.moistureBarrierWidthLengthBOQ: Moisture barrier = width × length → BOQ 9 item 4) (the BOQ adds 30%)
slabOnGrade.totalReinforcementMWidthLength: Total reinforcement (m) = width × length ÷ spacing × 2 directions × layers → BOQ 9 item 5), one row per bar size + 3% tie wire
slabOnGrade.structuralConcreteWidthLengthThickness: Structural concrete = width × length × thickness → BOQ 9 item 6)
slabOnGrade.drainPipesBOQ9Item: Drain pipes (BOQ 9 item 1) are calculated by the drain pipe program

stair.noStairsYetCheckThe: No stairs yet — check the stair detail and add one flight at a time (number of steps, riser, tread and width)
stair.totalRiseAndHorizontalRun: Total rise and horizontal run are filled from the number of steps — edit them if there is a landing
stair.presetToRB9015: Preset to RB9 @0.15 m — edit to match the stair detail
stair.concreteWaistSlabThicknessSloped: Concrete = waist slab (thickness × sloped length × width) + steps (number of steps × ½ × tread × riser × width)
stair.formworkSoffitWaistSlabSides: Formwork = soffit + waist slab sides + step sides + step risers · props = round up (soffit area ÷ 0.6) pcs
stair.waistSlabMainBarsRound: Waist slab main bars = round up (width ÷ spacing) bars × (sloped length +
stair.waistSlabCrackControlBars2: Waist slab crack-control bars = round up (sloped length ÷ spacing) bars × width
stair.stepMainBarsRoundUp: Step main bars = round up (width ÷ spacing) bars × (horizontal run + total rise) · step crack-control bars = 2 × number of steps × width
stair.mainReinforcementStringerQuantityRound: Main reinforcement - stringer: quantity = round up(width ÷ spacing), total length = (sloped length +
stair.crackControlBarsStringerQuantity: Crack-control bars - stringer: quantity = round up(sloped length ÷ spacing), total length = width × quantity
stair.mainReinforcementStepsQuantityRound: Main reinforcement - steps: quantity = round up(width ÷ spacing), total length = quantity × (horizontal run + rise)
stair.crackControlBarsStepsQuantity: Crack-control bars - steps: quantity = 2 × number of steps (spacing not used), total length = quantity × width
stair.reinforcementIsSentToThe: Reinforcement is sent to the BOQ by size with the allowance % per size (RB6 6%, RB9 9%, DB12–DB20 12%) and 3% tie wire
stair.propsRoundUpStringerSoffit: Props = round up(stringer soffit ÷ 0.6) pcs · soffit = width × sloped length · stringer sides = 2 × thickness × sloped length
stair.stepSides2RiserHeight: Step sides = 2 × riser height × sloped length · step risers = number of steps × riser height × width
stair.stringerConcreteThicknessSlopedLength: Stringer concrete = thickness × sloped length × width · steps = number of steps × ½ × tread × riser × width

structureSummary.thisTablePullsItsFigures: This table pulls its figures from each work sheet (tap a work name to edit) — edit the source sheet, not here. The total backfill also includes the backfill of the footings.

tempUtilities.thisPriceIsAStarting: This price is a starting cost; you can adjust the unit price
tempUtilities.ifTheDistanceToThe: If the distance to the power source is long, have an electrician check the actual cable size
tempUtilities.pipeAndElectricalFittingsAre: Pipe and electrical fittings are counted as a % to keep the BOQ uncluttered
tempUtilities.theMainBOQIsExported: The main BOQ is exported as a single item: temporary water and power
tempUtilities.wiringDistanceFromTheMeter: Wiring distance from the meter to the site
tempUtilities.waterPipeDistanceFromThe: Water pipe distance from the meter to the site
tempUtilities.roundUpWaterDistance4: Round up water distance ÷ 4 m × (1 + wastage %)
tempUtilities.equalToTheNumberOf: Equal to the number of water points
tempUtilities.equalToTheNumberOf2: Equal to the number of light points/sockets
tempUtilities.temporaryWaterAndPowerPrice: Temporary water and power price summary
tempUtilities.bahtSentToTheBOQ: baht sent to the BOQ row "Temporary water and power" (material column, 1 lump sum) — the labour for this row is entered on the BOQ page
tempUtilities.waterAndPowerUsedDuring: Water and power used during construction

toiletTile.enterTheFloorSizeAnd: Enter the floor size and it is calculated for you: 2 × (width + length)
toiletTile.theOpeningsAreLargerThan: The openings are larger than the wall area — check the room perimeter, height or opening sizes
toiletTile.notSelectedNotCountedIn: Not selected — not counted in the BOQ
toiletTile.noBathroomsYetOpenThe: No bathrooms yet — open the bathroom plan and add one room at a time (room size, tiled height and openings)
